integrity: The finite checker supports arithmetic identities, not the infinite asymptotic; no independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Fixed modulus q>=2 only; period theorem and effective prime-number theorem used as external proved inputs; no uniformity in growing q, no best-possible error or independent mathematical audit. The leading log 2 law is an antecedent of smooth-number theory; the claimed contribution is the explicit centered second-order coprimality bias.
title: A second-order coprimality bias in consecutive-LCM least periods
